# @dotos/dui v8 Complete AI & LLM Reference (`llms-full.txt`)

> Complete specification for `@dotos/dui/standalone`, `@dotos/dui/schema`, M3 `--dui-*` / `--mat-sys-*` design tokens, WAI-ARIA keyboard contracts, and strict enterprise guardrails on Angular 22 + TypeScript 6.
> `@dotos/dui` v8 完整 AI 代码生成参考手册（涵盖选型矩阵、完整 Signal 签名、M3 令牌规范、JSON Schema 元模型与五大反模式红线）。

---

## 1. Five Strict Anti-Pattern Bans / 五大反模式禁令（强制门禁）

1. **Ban #1 — 严禁在新组件写 `NgModule` / `standalone: false`**
   Every newly generated component, directive, or pipe MUST explicitly declare `standalone: true` and `changeDetection: ChangeDetectionStrategy.OnPush`.
2. **Ban #2 — 严禁假设 `Zone.js` 存在**
   All state must live in Angular `signal()`, `computed()`, `input()`, and `model()`. Never rely on `setTimeout` mutation without updating a Signal. Bootstrap with `provideDuiZoneless()`.
3. **Ban #3 — 严禁写 `::ng-deep` 或 `.mdc-*` 内部选择器**
   Customize surfaces, typography, and density strictly via `--dui-*` and `--mat-sys-*` CSS custom properties.
4. **Ban #4 — 严禁使用 `fxLayout` / `fxFlex` / `fxLayoutGap`**
   Use standard CSS Grid (`display: grid; grid-template-columns: ...`) and CSS Flexbox (`display: flex; gap: ...`), or `<dui-standalone-split-dock>`.
5. **Ban #5 — 严禁使用 `any`、隐式空对象 `= {}` 或双重断言 `as unknown as T`**
   Type all payloads explicitly; for dynamic forms use `DuiFormSchema`, `DuiFormPrimitiveValue`, and `validateDuiFormSchema(input: unknown)` from `@dotos/dui/schema`.

---

## 2. Component Selection Matrix / 组件选型矩阵

| Use Case / 场景 | Import Path | Component / Function | Key Capabilities / 核心能力 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Zoneless Bootstrap | `@dotos/dui/standalone` | `provideDuiZoneless()` | Wraps `provideZonelessChangeDetection()` for zero-`Zone.js` apps |
| Enterprise Actions | `@dotos/dui/standalone` | `DuiButtonComponent` (`<dui-standalone-button>`) | 6 variants, 3 density sizes, `loading` spinner, Guardrail A imperative API |
| Dashboard / Detail Panel | `@dotos/dui/standalone` | `DuiCardComponent` (`<dui-standalone-card>`) | Header/extra/body/footer slots, M3 surface container & elevation |
| Multi-View Switching | `@dotos/dui/standalone` | `DuiTabsComponent` (`<dui-standalone-tabs>`) | Two-way `activeId = model<string>()`, WAI-ARIA `tablist` + Arrow/Home/End |
| IDE / SCADA Split Workspace | `@dotos/dui/standalone` | `DuiSplitDockComponent` (`<dui-standalone-split-dock>`) | Native CSS Grid horizontal/vertical dock, `collapsed = model<boolean>(false)` |
| Asset / BOM Hierarchy | `@dotos/dui/standalone` | `DuiTreeViewComponent` (`<dui-standalone-tree>`) | Zero-MobX Signal tree, WAI-ARIA `tree`/`treeitem`, Up/Down/Left/Right/Home/End |
| Data Entry & Config Forms | `@dotos/dui/standalone` | `DuiSchemaFormComponent` (`<dui-standalone-form>`) | Zero-`any` CSS Grid form driven by `DuiFormSchema`, built-in validation |
| Schema Validation & MCP Self-Healing | `@dotos/dui/schema` | `validateDuiFormSchema(input)` | Draft 2020-12 `DUI_FORM_JSON_SCHEMA` + structured `Finding[]` with `hint` |

---

## 3. Exact Signal API Signatures / 完整 `input()` / `model()` / `output()` 签名

### 3.1 `provideDuiZoneless` (`@dotos/dui/standalone`)
```ts
export function provideDuiZoneless(): EnvironmentProviders;
```

### 3.2 `DuiButtonComponent` (`<dui-standalone-button>`)
```ts
export type DuiButtonVariant = 'primary' | 'secondary' | 'tonal' | 'outlined' | 'ghost' | 'danger';
export type DuiButtonSize = 'compact' | 'normal' | 'loose';

class DuiButtonComponent {
  readonly variant: InputSignal<DuiButtonVariant>; // default: 'primary'
  readonly size: InputSignal<DuiButtonSize>;       // default: 'normal'
  readonly disabled: InputSignal<boolean>;         // default: false
  readonly loading: InputSignal<boolean>;          // default: false
  readonly icon: InputSignal<string>;              // default: ''
  readonly type: InputSignal<'button' | 'submit' | 'reset'>; // default: 'button'
  readonly clicked: OutputEmitterRef<MouseEvent>;

  // Guardrail A imperative methods / 护栏 A 命令式兼容方法
  setVariant(nextVariant: DuiButtonVariant | null): void;
  setSize(nextSize: DuiButtonSize | null): void;
  setDisabled(isDisabled: boolean | null): void;
  setLoading(isLoading: boolean | null): void;
  setIcon(nextIcon: string | null): void;
}
```

### 3.3 `DuiCardComponent` (`<dui-standalone-card>`)
```ts
export type DuiCardPadding = 'none' | 'compact' | 'normal' | 'loose';

class DuiCardComponent {
  readonly title: InputSignal<string>;          // default: ''
  readonly subtitle: InputSignal<string>;       // default: ''
  readonly elevated: InputSignal<boolean>;      // default: false
  readonly padding: InputSignal<DuiCardPadding>; // default: 'normal'
  // Slots: [duiCardHeaderExtra], default body, [duiCardFooter]
}
```

### 3.4 `DuiTabsComponent` (`<dui-standalone-tabs>`)
```ts
export interface DuiTabItem {
  readonly id: string;
  readonly label: string;
  readonly icon?: string;
  readonly disabled?: boolean;
  readonly badge?: string | number;
}

class DuiTabsComponent {
  readonly tabs: InputSignal<readonly DuiTabItem[]>; // input.required
  readonly activeId: ModelSignal<string | undefined>; // [(activeId)]
  readonly resolvedActiveId: Signal<string>;
  selectTab(id: string): void;
}
```

### 3.5 `DuiSplitDockComponent` (`<dui-standalone-split-dock>`)
```ts
export type DuiDockDirection = 'horizontal' | 'vertical';

class DuiSplitDockComponent {
  readonly direction: InputSignal<DuiDockDirection>; // default: 'horizontal'
  readonly sidebarSize: InputSignal<string>;         // default: '260px'
  readonly sidebarTitle: InputSignal<string>;        // default: ''
  readonly collapsed: ModelSignal<boolean>;          // default: false, [(collapsed)]
  toggleCollapsed(): void;
  // Slots: [duiDockSidebar], default main workspace
}
```

### 3.6 `DuiTreeViewComponent` (`<dui-standalone-tree>`)
```ts
export interface DuiTreeNodeItem {
  readonly id: string;
  readonly label: string;
  readonly icon?: string;
  readonly disabled?: boolean;
  readonly children?: readonly DuiTreeNodeItem[];
  readonly data?: Readonly<Record<string, unknown>>;
}

class DuiTreeViewComponent {
  readonly nodes: InputSignal<readonly DuiTreeNodeItem[]>; // input.required
  readonly ariaLabel: InputSignal<string>;                 // default: 'Navigation tree'
  readonly expandedIds: ModelSignal<readonly string[]>;    // default: [], [(expandedIds)]
  readonly selectedId: ModelSignal<string | null>;         // default: null, [(selectedId)]
  readonly nodeActivated: OutputEmitterRef<DuiTreeNodeItem>;
  expandNode(id: string): void;
  collapseNode(id: string): void;
  toggleExpand(id: string): void;
  activateNode(node: DuiTreeNodeItem): void;
}
```

### 3.7 `DuiSchemaFormComponent` (`<dui-standalone-form>`) & `@dotos/dui/schema`
```ts
export type DuiFormPrimitiveValue = string | number | boolean | null;
export type DuiFormFieldType =
  | 'text' | 'textarea' | 'number' | 'password' | 'email'
  | 'select' | 'radio' | 'checkbox' | 'switch' | 'date';

export interface DuiFormFieldConfig {
  readonly key: string;
  readonly label: string;
  readonly type: DuiFormFieldType;
  readonly placeholder?: string;
  readonly required?: boolean;
  readonly disabled?: boolean;
  readonly defaultValue?: DuiFormPrimitiveValue;
  readonly min?: number;
  readonly max?: number;
  readonly step?: number;
  readonly minLength?: number;
  readonly maxLength?: number;
  readonly pattern?: string;
  readonly hint?: string;
  readonly colSpan?: number;
  readonly options?: readonly DuiFormFieldOption[];
}

export interface DuiFormSchema {
  readonly id: string;
  readonly title?: string;
  readonly description?: string;
  readonly columns?: 1 | 2 | 3 | 4;
  readonly density?: 'compact' | 'normal' | 'loose';
  readonly submitLabel?: string;
  readonly resetLabel?: string;
  readonly fields: readonly DuiFormFieldConfig[];
}

export interface DuiSchemaFinding {
  readonly path: string;
  readonly code: string;
  readonly severity: 'error' | 'warning';
  readonly message: string;
  readonly hint: string; // Self-healing instruction for AI agents
}

export function validateDuiFormSchema(input: unknown): DuiSchemaValidationResult;
export const DUI_FORM_JSON_SCHEMA: DuiJsonSchemaObject; // Draft 2020-12

class DuiSchemaFormComponent {
  readonly schema: InputSignal<DuiFormSchema>; // input.required
  readonly value: ModelSignal<Record<string, DuiFormPrimitiveValue>>; // [(value)]
  readonly submitted: OutputEmitterRef<Record<string, DuiFormPrimitiveValue>>;
  resetForm(): void;
  handleSubmit(event?: Event): boolean;
}
```

---

## 4. Material 3 (`--mat-sys-*`) & DotOS (`--dui-*`) Design Tokens / 主题令牌规范

`ThemeService` injects all tokens onto `document.documentElement` (`data-theme="light" | "dark" | "darkblue"`) and sets `.dui-density-compact | .dui-density-normal | .dui-density-loose` on `document.body`:

| Token | Fallback / Role | Description / 语义说明 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--dui-primary` | `--mat-sys-primary` | Primary brand action fill & active indicator / 主品牌强调色 |
| `--dui-on-primary` | `--mat-sys-on-primary` | Text/icons on `--dui-primary` / 主色背景上的前景文字 |
| `--dui-primary-container` | `--mat-sys-primary-container` | Tonal badge & selected row container / 主色柔和容器 |
| `--dui-accent` | `--mat-sys-tertiary` | Secondary/tertiary highlight link or accent / 辅助强调色 |
| `--dui-warn` | `--mat-sys-error` | Danger button & validation error state / 危险与校验错误色 |
| `--dui-surface` | `--mat-sys-surface` | Base page/workspace canvas background / 页面画布背景色 |
| `--dui-surface-container` | `--mat-sys-surface-container` | Card, dock sidebar, and window container surface / 卡片与停靠侧栏背景色 |
| `--dui-on-surface` | `--mat-sys-on-surface` | Primary readable text color / 主文本前景色 |
| `--dui-outline-variant` | `--mat-sys-outline-variant` | Subtle 1px structural divider/border / 1px 结构分割线色 |
| `--dui-hover` | `rgba(...)` | Adaptive hover overlay for light/dark/darkblue / 悬停态半透明叠色 |
| `--dui-selected` | `--mat-sys-primary-container` | Active tree/list selection highlight / 选中项高亮背景色 |
